description: Explain how Agentropolis computes trust scores (method hub-trust-v0.1) and ranks search results: which payment evidence counts, wash-trading exclusions, low-sample caps, why our own test purchases never count, and what a null score means. Use it to interpret the trust and badge fields from search_kits or get_kit; it returns the method, not any listing's score. Read-only, no parameters.
name: get_trust_method
title: Explain how trust scores and ranking work
